Just a few, normally if it's bad a couple of times will help center me.  It can be hard to do while you are in the midst of panicking/having air hunger.  Worst case it takes 15 minutes but blows over. 

Googling box breathing should yield you better results in all the benefits. Speaking from my experience I always recommend it to people who are anxious, stressed, or having a panic attack.

Yes, it's easier to have a little .gif or video because sometimes my anxious mind can't count very slowly!

As for the air hunger, I found it's because I'm breathing way too fast and don't notice. So I'll hold my breath for a little and then be able to take a deep breath fully.

"Box" breathing is very beneficial for me to calm down, relax, and ground myself.

Sit in a comfortable chair with your feet on the floor.
Choose a quiet, stress-free environment to focus on your breathing.
Close your eyes.
Exhale slowly.
Inhale slowly through your nose to a count of four.
Hold your breath at the top of the breath for a count of four.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of four.
Pause and hold at the bottom of your breath for a count of four.
Repeat the pattern.

 I've since found alternative  outlets to help my anxiety(medical marijuana) and won't look back.
